== Dune parallels ==

Hi, I am sorry to revert your Dune parallels edits, but there is a difference between a parallel, where Jordan may have intentionally alluded to a known figure in myth or legend and a trope, which is a character type that recurs throughout fiction. I would prefer the wiki be less speculative in these areas and stick to facts within the series and other canon sources. [[User:Moridin 2000|Moridin_2000]] ([[User talk:Moridin 2000|talk]]) 16:25, 27 January 2021 (UTC)
